hook: Three Goldman Sachs subsidiaries faced criminal charges over 6.5 billion dollars in hidden bond deals.

sections.voiceover: Three Goldman Sachs subsidiaries faced criminal charges over 6.5 billion dollars in hidden bond deals.
Attorney-General Tommy Thomas announced the action in Kuala Lumpur. Malaysia filed the criminal charges regarding the state investment fund 1MDB. Where did the missing money go?
However, Goldman Sachs made untrue statements in offering circulars for the 1MDB bond sales.
Goldman Sachs omitted key facts during the bond sales. The firm handled 6.5 billion dollars for the 1MDB fund. Malaysia charged two employees alongside the three subsidiaries.
6.5 billion dollars linked three subsidiaries to criminal charges.
